title: Astronomer in the Library
description: A young woman with long dark hair and floral accessories sits in an ornate library, holding an armillary sphere while gazing at a large celestial globe. She is surrounded by glowing candles, scattered tarot cards, bookshelves, and a massive telescope projecting a beam of warm light across a painted dome ceiling with floating moths.
prompt: A young woman with long dark hair adorned with white flowers sits in a grand ornate library with painted dome ceiling. She wears a dark blue and gold Victorian-style dress with a cloak, holding an armillary sphere in one hand while seated beside a large detailed terrestrial and celestial globe. A massive brass telescope angles down from above, casting a dramatic warm orange beam of light. Scattered tarot cards and glowing candles cover the floor around her. Moths flutter in the light, cinematic lighting, intricate details, atmospheric fantasy scene.
